landing.pitch: SplitStack is a mobile-first group expense splitter. Track shared costs, simplify debts, and settle up with friends.
landing.tagline: Installable PWA · works offline · dark mode

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: SplitStack can't reach the network right now. Your balances will be here when you're back — check your connection and try again.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to split expenses with your groups.
auth.demoHint: Demo: alex@demo.com, sarah@demo.com or mike@demo.com — password {password}
auth.magicLinkNote: Prefer email? We'll send you a secure sign-in link — no password needed.
auth.checkEmailDescription: A sign-in link is on its way. Click it to continue — you can close this tab.

home.title: Your groups
home.emptyDescription: Create a group to start splitting expenses with friends, roommates or travel buddies.

group.emptyDescription: Add the first shared expense to start tracking balances in this group.

settings.title: Group settings
settings.inviteSuccess: Invite added — they'll join automatically when they sign in
settings.leaveHint: You can leave once your balance in this group is settled.
settings.leaveDescription: Leave this group. Only possible once your balance is settled.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanently delete this group and all of its expenses and settlements.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? All expenses and settlements will be permanently removed.
settings.adminOnlyNote: Only group admins can delete the group.

expense.equalNote: Split evenly — leftover cents go to the payer first.
expense.deleteConfirm: Delete this expense? Balances will be recalculated.

settle.title: Settle up
settle.noDebts: Nothing to settle — everyone is squared away 🎉
settle.partialNote: You can record a partial payment — the rest stays as a balance.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyDescription: Group events — expenses, settlements, new members — will show up here.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noDataDescription: Add some expenses and your spending insights will appear here.

errors.exactSumMismatch: Shares must add up to the total
errors.samePerson: Payer and recipient can't be the same person
errors.sendFailed: Could not send the sign-in email. Try again.
errors.nameTooLong: Name must be 50 characters or fewer
errors.notMember: You're not a member of this group
errors.alreadyPending: This person already has a pending invite
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member
errors.settleFirst: Settle your balance before leaving the group
errors.lastAdmin: You're the only admin — delete the group or make another member admin first
errors.adminOnly: Only group admins can delete the group
